patterns.note: A mix of asymmetrical introductory text blocks and a structured, responsive grid layout for portfolio items and news, creating visual interest while maintaining content organization.

A consistent use of a modern sans-serif font family (Inter) across various weights and sizes, with a strong emphasis on very large, bold display headings and smaller, uppercase labels for section titles.
A high-contrast black and white base palette is dramatically punctuated by vibrant, almost neon, abstract accent colors primarily within the 3D hero graphics and select project imagery.

A sticky header maintains navigation visibility, while the initial hero section features dynamic, canvas-based 3D spherical graphics that subtly parallax and animate as the user scrolls, eventually moving out of view.
The footer features a distinctive, large-scale 'dirt' logo rendered with a complex refractive, glass-like effect, serving as a unique and memorable brand signature.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar transitions to a fixed position at the top of the viewport after initial scroll, maintaining its layout and functionality.

The initial hero section features a row of interactive 3D spherical graphics rendered using a canvas element, which animate and parallax subtly as the user scrolls, eventually scrolling out of view. This uses detected 'canvas' animation tech.
The large 'dirt' logo in the footer is rendered with a complex refractive, glass-like effect, likely achieved through advanced CSS filters or WebGL, giving it a translucent, dimensional quality.

design_tokens.type_scale: A dramatic contrast between oversized, bold display headings (up to ~5x body text) and smaller, regular-weight body text, with uppercase labels used for section titles.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and image cards, with perfectly circular abstract graphics.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between major content sections, but a tighter grid system for portfolio items.

standout: The site distinguishes itself with its highly artistic and dynamic 3D abstract hero graphics and a unique, large-scale glass-effect logo in the footer. These elements create a sophisticated, almost gallery-like feel that elevates it beyond a standard agency portfolio.
